validity.recommendation: Correct LengthKnown 190 -> 240 km (= 480 km pair / 2), matching the source and the halving convention used for sibling packages P6723/24 (370->185) and P6725/26 (340->170). Diameter 56 in and all else stay.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed, high. This is Package 8 of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3). MEED (the row's own cited source) explicitly lists it: 'Package 8: Laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-8 to EWPS-10, covering 480km.' url_verifier confirmed the MEED page returns 200 and contains 'EWPS-8 to EWPS-10, covering 480' and '56-inch'. Independently corroborated by (a) DMS Projects, which has a dedicated Package-8 record 'Master Gas System Expansion - Phase 3 - Package 8 - EWPS-8 to EWPS-10 Pipeline' (PRJ00030609, verified 200 + 'EWPS-8'/'EWPS-10'), and (b) Blackridge Research MGS-3 profile (verified 200 + 'EWPS-8 to EWPS-10' + '480'). Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct - a 56-inch east-west gas TRANSMISSION trunk forming part of the national Master Gas System backbone; commodity gas; PipelineType transmission. Not gathering/process/lateral. DUPLICATE CHECK: P6727 ('EWPS-8-EWPS-10 "3"', same 190 km / 56 in) is the PARALLEL line 3 of the identical EWPS-8->EWPS-10 corridor. MEED names 'pipelines three and four' (two physical parallel lines per package), so P6727 (line 3) and P6728 (line 4) are two real parallel pipes, NOT a double-count - same construction as the confirmed P6723/P6724 pair. No duplicate against any other roster PID. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco 100% correct (Aramco owns/operates the Master Gas System). Fuel Gas correct. Endpoints EWPS-8 (East-West Pump Station 8) -> EWPS-10 within Saudi Arabia; per-segment province not stated, left unfilled (no fabrication). SPEC - THE FINDING: LengthKnown=190 km per line disagrees with the cited source. MEED (and independently Blackridge) state the EWPS-8->EWPS-10 package covers 480 km for lines three and four combined; GEM's own per-line halving convention (verified on siblings: EWPS-4->EWPS-6 370->185 each; EWPS-6->EWPS-8 340->170 each) yields 240 km per line here, not 190. GEM's 190 (380 pair) reconciles with neither the raw 480 nor the halved 240 - it is ~50 km/line (~100 km pair) short and unsupported by the only cited source. Two independent sources agree on 480 => recommend LengthKnown 190 -> 240. Diameter 56 in explicitly confirmed by MEED. Capacity blank and left blank - MGS-3 adds ~3.15 bscfd across ~4,150 km total; no defensible per-segment capacity, so not fabricated. StartYear1 2028 matches the project's Q4 2028 target completion.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status 'construction' still correct. MGS-3 EPC contracts (incl. Package 8) awarded March 2024; construction commenced Q2 2024; target completion Q4 2028 (MEED, JPT/SPE both verified). Newer project-wide evidence of active construction: Pipeline Journal (Sep 2025, verified 200 + 'Master Gas System') reports L&T completing a 56-inch MGS-3 pipeline section and mobilizing on a further stretch - the program is mid-construction, not stalled. CAVEAT on a false positive: the DMS Projects Package-8 page shows a 'Completed' flag, but that reflects a sub-scope only (per search evidence, YSG completed the prefabricated portable/portacabin buildings for Package 8 by April 2025) - NOT the pipeline itself, which targets Q4 2028. No independent evidence the EWPS-8->EWPS-10 lines are mechanically complete or in service, and no start-up date => stays 'construction', not 'operating'. Well under any dormancy threshold (awarded 2024, active 2025). StartYear1 2028 matches the Q4 2028 target. Aramco's own 2024 press release (aramco.com/...25bn-contract-awards) is a further corroborating source but repeatedly ReadTimeout'd in url_verifier, so it is intentionally NOT cited.

summary: P6728 (MGS-3 EWPS-8->EWPS-10 line 4, 56in gas transmission) is real, correctly classified, Aramco-owned, construction status valid; SPEC concern: LengthKnown 190 km disagrees with the cited source (MEED + Blackridge: 480 km for the pair) -> should be 240 km/line per GEM's own halving convention. P6727 is the legit parallel line 3, not a duplicate.
